text:
Your biggest mistake isn't lack of hustle. It's lack of plan.

You've got energy. You know you want more. But energy without direction is just noise.

Wealthy men separate themselves one way: they build a definite plan.

Not a feeling. Not a vision board. A real plan.

What's the number. What's the date. What's the exact sequence of actions. What's the burning desire that wakes you up.

You're not lazy. You're misdirected.

That changes the moment you write down your plan. Not tomorrow. Not next week. Today.

Build it now.
caption:
You can't build what you haven't defined. Vague goals produce vague results. Men with discipline and clear plans create wealth. You can.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
